problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 6 delivery routes through 6 distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling stages represented as pairs (Center, Duration),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the stage must occur and the time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the stages must be performed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C4, 6) → (C6, 1) → (C2, 2) → (C1, 4) → (C3, 2) → (C5, 9)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C4, 3) → (C1, 5) → (C3, 7) → (C5, 3) → (C2, 10) → (C6, 3)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C4, 8) → (C3, 1) → (C1, 9) → (C6, 1) → (C5, 9) → (C2, 7)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C2, 4) → (C3, 5) → (C1, 6) → (C4, 5) → (C5, 5) → (C6, 9)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C4, 10) → (C2, 3) → (C6, 9) → (C3, 1) → (C1, 6) → (C5, 2)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C2, 3) → (C4, 8) → (C6, 9) → (C5, 1) → (C1, 9) → (C3, 2)

Each handling stage must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each distribution center can only handle one stage at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing order of all stages at the distribution centers
so that the total completion time of all routes is minimized.
